item.title: Export button does nothing
item.body: I click export and no file downloads.

output.reply:
Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for contacting Acme Support. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you have experienced with the export function. To assist you further, kindly provide your account ID and the browser you are using. A member of our team will review your case and follow up within one business day.

Warm regards,
Acme Support Team

item.title: Report shows wrong totals

output.reply:

item.title: How do I add a teammate?

output.reply:
Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for your inquiry. We are delighted to assist you in adding a teammate. Please navigate to Settings and select Team Members, where you may extend an invitation. Should you require further guidance, our team remains at your service.

Warm regards,
Acme Support Team
